name.zh: 盖德罗尼可夺舍不死系统

periods.description: Gedronika achieves immortality by scattering dragon-blood descendants across worlds and periodically transferring her soul into a young female descendant adapted to the local environment.
periods.principles: Bloodline sympathy locates coordinates; vessel memory is read; new body provides youth and environmental adaptation.
limitations: if vessel plus soul are destroyed she risks true death
